why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate rose 0.81%, past the 0.50% bar, so the new ranker does help searches end in a good click.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Latency p95 rose 3.10%, against a 2.00% margin; a heavier lambdamart_v7 model scoring each query is the likely cause.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: The scorecard has no segment cuts, so which queries got slower is unknown.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A test run with the latency cost brought under 2.00% (model distillation or caching) while Successful Search Rate keeps its gain.
A written, owner-signed waiver of the 2.00% latency margin, with the trade-off accepted, would move this to the triage meeting.
A pre-period comparison and a daily series by days since first exposure would let the two checks that could not run be completed.
